dataset: Synthetic demonstration scenarios; no person, employer, or production system is represented.

scenarios.title: A latency spike
scenarios.caption: A change worth investigating
scenarios.summary: A sample service shows a short-lived increase in request latency after a fictional deployment.

evidence.description: synthetic five-minute latency sample; p95 rises from 180 ms to 420 ms

scenarios.supports: The rise follows the example deployment window and appears in two consecutive samples.
scenarios.contradicts: The sample window is small; upstream network delay is also plausible.
scenarios.decision: Investigate deployment and network traces before attributing cause.
scenarios.next_check: Compare a longer baseline and a second source at 10:30 UTC.
scenarios.change_condition: A second independent trace locates the delay or the elevated latency persists.

scenarios.title: Conflicting status updates
scenarios.caption: Hold the conclusion open
scenarios.summary: Two example status sources disagree about whether a service incident is resolved.

evidence.description: synthetic status feed marks resolved; EVD-202 synthetic probe still fails

scenarios.contradicts: EVD-202 records a failed probe after the resolution timestamp.
scenarios.decision: Mark resolution unverified and request an owner check.
scenarios.next_check: Repeat the probe and compare the owner update at 11:30 UTC.
scenarios.change_condition: The probe passes and the owner confirms recovery, or a new incident is identified.

scenarios.title: An early improvement
scenarios.caption: Monitor before declaring a trend
scenarios.summary: A fictional queue shrinks after an intervention, but there is too little history to claim a durable improvement.

evidence.description: synthetic queue depth falls from 68 to 24 across three samples

scenarios.supports: The immediate direction matches the intervention's expected effect.
scenarios.contradicts: Only three samples exist; load varies during the day.
scenarios.decision: Continue monitoring and freeze the original prediction for later comparison.
scenarios.next_check: Review a full day of comparable traffic at 12:00 UTC the next day.
scenarios.change_condition: The improvement persists under similar load without an offsetting failure mode.
